description: This file defines FastAPI routes, dependency overrides, and test cases for dependency injection, focusing on testing overridden dependencies.

methods.name: common_parameters( q: Union[str, None] = None, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100 )
methods.description: Defines common query parameters for multiple endpoints with default values, returns them as a dictionary.

methods.name: read_items(commons: dict = Depends(common_parameters))
methods.description: GET endpoint at /items/ that uses dependency injection to access common parameters and returns a greeting message with parameters.

methods.name: read_users(commons: dict = Depends(common_parameters))
methods.description: GET endpoint at /users/ that uses dependency injection to access common parameters and returns a greeting message with parameters.

methods.name: override_dependency(q: Union[str, None] = None)
methods.description: Overrides the default dependency to return fixed skip and limit values, with optional query parameter q.

methods.name: test_override_in_items()
methods.description: Test case verifying the override_dependency works for /items/ endpoint with default parameters.

methods.name: test_override_in_items_with_q()
methods.description: Test case verifying override with specific query parameter q for /items/ endpoint.

methods.name: test_override_in_items_with_params()
methods.description: Test case verifying override with query parameters q, skip, and limit for /items/ endpoint.
